meta.name: explore-code
meta.description: Rigor Improve implementation leaf skill for auditable candidate implementation in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory work on an isolated branch or worktree to transplant modules, adapt a backbone, add LoRA or adapter layers, replace a head, or stitch together meaningful low-risk migration ideas with rollback-aware records in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline reproduction, conservative debugging, environment setup, verified contribution claims, or default repository analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让研究代码里的模型改动变成可回溯、可回滚的探索实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你是深度学习研究者,总想在代码里尝试改模型,又怕改坏回不去。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do experimental edits to DL research code and need every change recoverable.

howto.what: 在隔离分支或 worktree 上做探索性代码改动:移植模块、适配骨干、插入 LoRA/adapter、替换 head,并把候选变更、回滚方式与可比性写进 explore_outputs/。
howto.when: 当你明确授权在隔离分支或 worktree 上做探索改动,且任务是模块移植、骨干适配、LoRA 插入等低风险改动时接管;未授权或属于可信基线、调试、大范围重构时不适用。

say.text: 在隔离分支上把论文里的模块移植进仓库
say.note: 记录改动原因与回滚方式

say.text: 给骨干网络加一层 LoRA 适配,结果只算候选
把这个改动和基线做可比性分析,写份报告

howto.what_en: On an isolated branch or worktree it makes exploratory code changes such as module transplants, backbone adaptation, LoRA/adapter insertion or head replacement, and writes candidate records with rollback notes to explore_outputs/.
howto.when_en: Use when you explicitly authorize exploratory edits on an isolated branch or worktree for low-risk, source-anchored changes; not for trusted baselines, debugging or broad refactors.

say_en.text: Transplant this paper's module into the repo on an isolated branch
say_en.note: Records why and how to roll back

say_en.text: Add a LoRA adapter to the backbone and keep it a candidate
Compare this change with the baseline and write a comparability report
